Classic Margarita

The perfect balance of tart and sweet. Makes 1 cocktail.

Ingredients

  • 50 ml tequila
  • 25 ml triple sec
  • 25 ml fresh lime juice
  • Salt for the rim, ice cubes

Method

  1. Rub a lime wedge around the rim of the glass and dip it in salt.
  2. Shake the tequila, triple sec and lime juice with ice.
  3. Strain into the glass and garnish with a lime wheel.
